The box room in the Partick flat, 2.4 m by 3.1 m, ceiling 2.7 m. Turned into a tracking room in spring 2024 so I could stop paying £40 an hour at Gorbals Sound for guitar overdubs. This note is the gear and the room. How I actually mix singers is in [[Mixing vocals]].

## The interface

Focusrite Clarett+ 4Pre, bought used from Ally McKechnie for £340 in March 2024 (serial ends 7Q41). Four mic preamps, which is enough for me plus a singer plus a stereo pair on an acoustic. Runs at 48 kHz, 24-bit. Buffer 128 samples for tracking, round trip latency measured at 6.2 ms with the loopback test. Fine for guitar, fine for drums I'm told, though nobody has played drums in my box room and nobody will.

## Microphones

- Shure SM7B. Guitar cabs and most voices. Needs a lot of gain, so it goes through a Cloudlifter CL-1 (£139).
- Neumann TLM 102. Acoustic guitar, brighter voices. Borrowed for two years from Fergus Laidlaw, finally bought it off him for £420 in August 2024.
- Two Rode M5 pencil condensers for the stereo pair on the Lowden. XY, 90 degrees, about 30 cm from the 12th fret.
- One SM57 that has been dropped down a stairwell at the Barrowland and still works.

## Monitoring

Yamaha HS7 on IsoAcoustics Aperta stands, tweeters at ear height, 1.1 m equilateral triangle. Sub? No. Room is too small, the low end would just pile up in the corners. Headphones: Beyerdynamic DT 770 Pro 80 ohm for tracking, Sennheiser HD 650 for checking.

## Acoustic treatment

Six home-made panels, 60 x 120 cm, 100 mm Rockwool RW3 in pine frames with Camira fabric. Total cost about £210 including the fabric, which was half of it. Two at first reflection points on the side walls, one on the ceiling cloud above the desk, three stacked in the corners behind me as bass traps. Before treatment there was a 9 dB peak around 110 Hz. After, about 4 dB. Measured with REW and a Behringer ECM8000.

## Power and hum

The single-coil hum on the Tele was horrible until I moved the studio onto its own circuit. The electrician (Danny Rourke, £95 call-out) found the box room was sharing a ring with the fridge freezer. Labelled it properly afterwards, see [[Fuse box labels]].

## DAW and plugins

Reaper 7, licence £60. I like it because it does what it's told and doesn't have opinions. Template file `GTR-TRACK-v3.rpp` has DI plus two mic tracks per guitar, already routed to a submix bus.

## Money and tax

Total spend up to January 2025: roughly £2,150 on the room. Since the room is used for paid session work at least 60% of the week, my accountant says part of the room counts. Notes on that in [[Home office deduction]]. Strings and consumables live in [[Guitar string gauges]].

## Things still wrong

- The window rattles at about 180 Hz when the HS7s are loud. Foam tape on the frame, half fixed.
- Desk is too deep, the monitors sit 20 cm too far back.
- Neighbours below (the Okafors) are fine with guitar till 9pm but asked about the kick drum samples. Fair.
